item: Bloc rosters: a script the operator runs that proposes, never writes
summary: R738: the thirteen blocs stay EMPTY until a reviewed proposal. The operator runs scripts/bloc_roster_check.py: offline by default, prints the one host and the transport, refuses unknown or refused, asks only with --online, one WDQS read per bloc named by its enwiki title (ambiguous proposes nothing), members with ISO codes via P463 or P527 with dates at stated precision, each row with its statement address and fetch time. It never writes blocs.py. Report capped at 200 KB, cut in linear time from the largest bloc, cuts counted; partial report on interrupt. Two security reads applied.
